authorized_exact_optimizations.kd_neighbors: one batched cKDTree query_ball_point call per member fit followed by canonical ascending global neighbor-id sort for every CAD node; radius, inclusivity, local row order, and local fit inputs remain exact

authorized_exact_optimizations.nuisance_design: cache immutable nuisance design for one exact nodes/fixed-centroid identity; returned numeric bytes and solve sequence remain exact
authorized_exact_optimizations.graph_allocations: remove only provably dead graph and edge-weight lookup allocations from induced-component evaluation
authorized_exact_optimizations.frozen_runner_dependency_binding: the frozen runner references scipy.sparse.csgraph.dijkstra in changed-component robustness comparison without importing it; V5 may scope-bind that exact SciPy primitive for execution and must restore the runner namespace afterward; differential reference runs bind the identical primitive and no algorithm substitution is authorized
authorized_exact_optimizations.component_medoid: stream exact Dijkstra rows in fixed consecutive source-ID batches of at most 128 instead of materializing a full component distance matrix; batch sources preserve ascending component-node order, each returned row uses the same destination-node order and math.fsum term order, peak distance workspace is bounded by 128 x full-graph-node-count, and the bounded active-mask cache returns deep copies because attribution mutates components

source_independent_production_scale_enve.failure_policy: any wall, RSS, scaling, bundle, or tree-equality failure is terminal source-free nonqualification; no envelope reduction or partial-payload promotion
